packageRules.description: Auto-merge digest updates (same tag, new content)
Protect the mios.toml SSOT  an exact-pin bump there reprojects into every generated surface, so it gets a human

customManagers.description: Pin digest of BASE_IMAGE ARG in Containerfile  the dockerfile manager only pins bare FROM lines, not ARG defaults

Bump the EXACT-pinned [image.sidecars] entries in the mios.toml SSOT (pgvector, k3s). Float refs (:latest/:main/major-only) are deliberately unmanaged: ADR-0012 resolves those at build and records the digest in the SBOM. pinDigests is off on purpose  a hand-written @sha256 in the SSOT is exactly what ADR-0003 and check_no_hardcode_version forbid.
